entries.title: N26 campaigns are live 🎉
entries.body: Campaign management for N26 is here. You can now create campaigns, invite players, track territories, record battles, create custom assets and log dice rolls.

entries.title: Advancements have arrived
entries.body: We’re continuing to drop progression features as we prepare to launch campaigns. Advancements just landed — here’s what’s new.

entries.title: Spyrer augmentations, founding TP budgets, credit management and more
entries.body: We’ve released a tonne of new features today as we tie up the loose ends on gang-building, debut our powerful new Action flow tools and clear the ground for campaigns to launch.

entries.title: Necromunda Roleplay revealed
entries.body: Games Workshop has announced a new underhive game system, Necromunda Roleplay. While there’s not much information yet, here’s what it means for Gyrinx:

entries.title: House of Blades and House of Chains are live
entries.body: Gyrinx now supports both House of Blades and House of Chains content, ready for when the journals drop next week.
